text:
mike: quick sync after the RFC review. proposing a two-stage migration pattern: stage A = deploy sidecar shim that translates v3->v1, stage B = migrate hotpaths into runtime v3 once stable.

nina: sidecar is lowest risk. questions: how do we handle streaming frames and incremental tokens across the shim boundary? need to preserve chunk framing.

oliver: we can transparently passthrough streaming frames if shim implements stream proxy and keeps seq ids. downside: double-hop adds ~6-12ms p50 in our perf env.

sara: that p50 hit is acceptable for opt-in cohorts. we should measure p95 and p99 too. if sidecar adds >20ms p99 we block.

mike: agree. telemetry contract (sketch):
```
metric: "compat.latency_ms" tags: { tier: "sidecar|runtime", cohort: "id" }
metric: "compat.5xx_rate" tags: { service, cohort }
event: "compat.quality_regression" fields: { prompt_id, similarity_score }
```

nina: add "compat.stream-loss" boolean when we detect dropped frames. also we need to surface model mismatch delta (embedding distance or token-level entropy).

oliver: for opt-in surface: prefer header + tenant flag. headers proposed:
```
X-Rwin-Compat: opt-in
X-Rwin-Cohort: c1234
```

sara: + dashboard toggle for enterprise admins. toggles must be RBAC controlled and emit audit logs. infra-bot: can you confirm audit sink?

infra-bot: audit-sink: events -> kafka -> s3-retention (90d). can add low-sensitivity callback to webhooks.

mike: rollback strategy: automatic fallback to v1 if ANY of these fire for 5m window: 1) compat.5xx_rate > 0.5%, 2) p99 latency increase > 30% absolute, 3) quality_regression count > 5 for golden set. Manual override also possible.

nina: golden set: we should curate 50 prompts per tenant class (chat, completion, embeddings). owners?

mike: infra + perf own the perf baseline. nina will own golden prompt curation. oliver owns sidecar implementation. sara owns rollout cadence and comms.

oliver: implementation notes: sidecar will be implemented as a lightweight proxy in go. it will do header sniffing, frame passthrough, and optionally canonicalize bodies for older clients. health endpoint `/shim-ready` with 200+ok JSON. image target ~100MB. canary in staging first.

sara: testing matrix before customer opt-in: schema compatibility tests, streaming frame fuzz, perf regression test, golden-set quality check, chaos test (kill sidecar, network latency).

mike: timeline suggestion: week 0: sidecar prototype + unit tests; week 1-2: internal e2e + perf; week 3: staging canary; week 4-6: limited customer cohorts; week 7+: broader ramp.

nina: comms draft: short note + header docs + dashboard screenshot. i'll draft.

sara: open questions: 1) do we gate any tenant types (enterprise vs self-serve)? 2) how do we compute model-mismatch threshold? 3) eviction semantics for KV cache across runtime migration? assign owners.

mike: i'll own tenant gating policy.

nina: model-mismatch threshold proposal: cosine distance > 0.12 or token-entropy delta > 0.3. i'll prototype.

oliver: i'll produce KV eviction compatibility matrix and migration checklist.

sara: good. next checkpoint in #architecture next Wed. tagging owners: @mike @nina @oliver. thanks everyone. :rocket:
